sections.shortTitle: Lahore College for Woman University Lahore Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2004
ACT III OF 2004
LAHORE COLLEGE FOR
WOMEN UNIVERSITY LAHORE (AMENDMENT)ACT, 2004
An Act to amend
the Lahore College for Women
University Lahore
Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 25th February, 2004]
No.PAP-Legis-2(18)/2003/576,
dated 23-2-2004.-----The Lahore College for Woman University, Lahore
(Amendment) Bill 2003, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on 7th January, 2004, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on
19th February, 2004, is hereby published as an Act of `the Provincial Assembly
of the
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Act may be called the Lahore College for Women
University, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2004;
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

It is hereby enacted as follows:-
4. Addition of section 11-A in
Ordinance XLIX of 2002.---In the said Ordinance, after section 11, the
following new section 11-A shall be added:--
"11-A Pro-Chancellor.---(1)
The Minister for Education, Government of the Punjab, shall be the
Pro-Chancellor of the University.
(2) He shall perform such duties
and functions and exercise such powers as may be assigned and delegated to him
by the Chancellor."

(i) in clause (xiii), the word
"and" occurring after the semicolon shall be omitted;
